corrections.prompt: Edit this illustration with one targeted correction only: make the black-and-white panda girl smaller in both head and body, about 20% smaller than she currently is, keeping her seated on the same cushion plane. The pink pig boy must be slightly larger than the panda, about 10% larger overall, so both are nearly equal tiny miniature companions. Preserve pig's existing size, face, pose and offered paw. Keep panda carefully applying the same tiny bandage to his paw, adjusting her reaching paw naturally. Keep the entire cottage background, camera, lighting, colors, style, composition and crop unchanged. No parent-child scale, no extra characters, no text.

Change the material and art medium of this scene ONLY into a clearly handmade POLYMER CLAY stop-motion diorama. The pink pig boy and slightly smaller black-and-white panda girl must be SMOOTH rounded matte clay sculptures, absolutely no fur, fuzz, felt, wool or hair on either animal. Use simple sculpted clay snout, rounded clay ears, black bead eyes, visible subtle fingerprints and seams. Make the cushion, open book and plants hand-sculpted clay miniatures too. The pig is about 10% larger than panda, both tiny and near-equal in size. Preserve the affectionate shared-reading pose, right-side composition, cottage setting, sage/peach/cream palette and soft lighting. This must look like photographed small clay figures, not plush toys. No text or watermark.

defaultStyle: Default medium for scenes without an explicit medium: soft painterly storybook environment, believable velvety plush fur on the two tiny animal companions, gentle cinematic natural lighting and tactile cottage textures. If a scene explicitly specifies watercolor, pencil, paper-cut, clay, gouache or pastel, fully follow that medium instead of realistic fur.
basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. One landscape 3:2 background illustration for a cozy diary website, full-bleed single scene. Character bible: one tiny round pink pig BOY and one tiny black-and-white panda GIRL (not red panda). Both are miniature plush-like companions with short limbs, round bodies and expressive soft faces; nearly equal body sizes, panda only about 10% smaller than pig in head and body at the same depth. Neither is an adult large animal. Equal companions with reciprocal affection and playful expressions, no parent-child dynamic, no exaggerated eyelashes or gender accessories. Layout: keep the LEFT HALF quiet and low-detail for diary overlay. Both characters and their main interaction together in the RIGHT 40%, heads at similar height around 50-60% of canvas height; complete small bodies about 30% of canvas height. Keep faces close together and readable in a shallow phone banner crop. No letters, writing, signage text, numbers, watermark, logos, UI, borders, collage.

scenes.title: 偷吃被發現
scenes.caption: 被發現了，也想分你一口
scenes.description: Pig boy is caught nibbling a cookie with tiny crumbs on his snout; panda girl gently points at the crumbs with an amused knowing smile while he sheepishly offers her half. Cozy cottage pantry. Soft mint, pale coral, fresh daylight.

scenes.title: 鼻尖的奶泡
scenes.caption: 你鼻子上，有一朵小白雲
scenes.description: Panda girl has a small dot of milk foam on her nose; pig boy giggles warmly while offering a tiny cloth, panda smiles in surprised embarrassment. Tiny cups on a cottage breakfast table. Cool sky blue, creamy white and berry pink.

scenes.title: 毛線纏住我們
scenes.caption: 繞了一圈，還是在一起
scenes.description: Both tiny companions sit side by side with a loose harmless loop of colorful yarn draped around their paws, laughing as they patiently untangle it together. Lilac and dusty teal, cozy craft nook, soft afternoon.

scenes.title: 追一頂小帽子
scenes.caption: 風把今天吹得好有趣
scenes.description: They scamper side by side along a cottage meadow path reaching for one small straw hat tumbling a short distance ahead in a playful breeze. Fresh blue sky, clover green and peach, lively wide scene.

scenes.title: 鬆餅翻面大作戰
scenes.caption: 小小失誤，大大的笑聲
scenes.description: Pig holds a tiny frying pan after flipping one pancake slightly sideways; panda beside him holds a plate trying to catch it, both laughing with surprise. Small pancake suspended between them, no dangerous fire. Pale lemon and soft aqua cottage kitchen.

scenes.title: 枕頭裡的小雪花
scenes.caption: 原來快樂，也會輕輕飄
scenes.description: They look surprised then delighted at a few soft feathers drifting from a small cushion with a loose seam, pig holds cushion while panda catches one feather. Cream and pale lavender cottage sofa, whimsical afternoon.

scenes.title: 擦乾小腦袋
scenes.caption: 把雨天留下的涼意擦掉
scenes.description: Both sit upright at the same level; pig gently pats panda's damp head with a little soft towel while panda holds a second towel ready for him. No human hair, just fluffy fur. Cool rain outside and warm cream inside, pale blue and apricot.

scenes.title: 貼一點溫柔
scenes.caption: 小小的痛，也有人在意
scenes.description: Panda carefully applies one tiny plain bandage to pig's offered paw, no blood or visible wound; pig smiles appreciatively, both equally small. Cottage window seat, soft sage and warm ivory, quiet gentle light.

scenes.title: 替你蓋好被子
scenes.caption: 你安心睡，我輕輕陪著
scenes.description: Pig dozes curled on a small cushion while panda gently pulls a light blanket over his shoulders, both nearly equal in body size. Cozy reading nook, muted periwinkle, cream and a single amber lamp.

scenes.title: 一碗暖暖的粥
scenes.caption: 把關心盛進小碗裡
scenes.description: Pig sets a small warm bowl of rice congee on a low table in front of panda, who holds a spoon and smiles; both seated beside each other, equal companions. Muted terracotta, pale jade and ivory, gentle steam.

scenes.title: 圍巾整理好了
scenes.caption: 出門以前，再多一點溫暖
scenes.description: Panda gently straightens pig's small knitted scarf while he holds her matching mittens, both standing at the same depth. Snowy cottage doorstep, dusty blue, cranberry and soft white.

scenes.title: 一起暖暖手
scenes.caption: 冷冷的天，有暖暖的你
scenes.description: Pig and panda sit shoulder to shoulder holding their paws around the same small warm ceramic mug, content quiet smiles. Soft snowfall beyond window. Muted plum, oatmeal and warm amber, intimate winter evening.

scenes.title: 老街的雞蛋糕
scenes.caption: 這一口，想和你一起吃
scenes.description: They share animal-shaped Taiwanese egg cakes from a small plain paper bag on an old Taiwanese brick street, pig offers a cake to panda. Warm red brick, turquoise shutters, subtle traditional arcade architecture, no readable signage, afternoon.

scenes.title: 海邊等一班火車
scenes.caption: 等車的時間，也有海風陪著
scenes.description: They sit close on a small bench at a quiet Taiwanese seaside railway platform, a distant local train and Pacific coast visible. Panda points toward train, pig holds a tiny travel bag. Ocean turquoise, pale blue and sunlit cream, no readable signs.

scenes.title: 騎樓下躲雨
scenes.caption: 雨下慢一點，我們就多待一會
scenes.description: Both tiny companions sit safely under a Taiwanese old-shop arcade looking out at a brief summer shower, sharing a dry small towel. Terrazzo pavement, tiled columns, potted plants. Cool teal rain, terracotta tile and warm yellow interior glow, no signs.

scenes.title: 山城的一壺茶
scenes.caption: 山裡的霧，杯裡的暖
scenes.description: Pig carefully pours tea into panda's tiny cup at a little mountain teahouse with Taiwan tea terraces and mist outside; subtle red lanterns to right. Moss green, slate gray, antique wood and muted red, no lettering.

scenes.title: 夜市的小玩具
scenes.caption: 把今晚的快樂撈回家
scenes.description: They play a Taiwanese night-market floating toy-scoop game using small shallow scoops, panda proudly lifts one small rubber duck while pig holds their little basket. ONLY plastic toys in shallow basin, no animals. Pink, turquoise and golden lantern bokeh, no readable signs, quiet corner without crowd.

scenes.title: 稻田邊的小旅行
scenes.caption: 跟著風，騎過金色的下午
scenes.description: Both ride two tiny appropriately scaled bicycles side by side on a flat Taiwanese rice-field lane, pig slightly larger, simple small helmets, gentle relaxed movement. Golden rice, distant green hills, blue sky and a few palms, no other characters.

scenes.title: 蘑菇傘下
scenes.caption: 小小的地方，也能裝下我們
scenes.description: Two miniature companions huddle happily side by side beneath one broad mushroom cap sheltering from soft rain, panda catches a droplet on a leaf and pig smiles. Enchanted woodland, muted teal, rose mushroom cap and soft green glow.

scenes.title: 葉子船出發
scenes.caption: 順著小溪，去找下一個驚喜
scenes.description: They sit safely together in one broad cupped leaf boat drifting on a very shallow magical garden stream; pig paddles with a tiny twig, panda points toward glowing flowers. Both tiny with same-scale bodies. Jade, clear turquoise and soft lilac.

scenes.title: 花瓣裡的小憩
scenes.caption: 今天睡在一朵花的懷裡
scenes.description: Pig and panda rest together in the broad open petals of one enormous soft flower, both small fluffy companions with gentle sleepy smiles, whole flower and both bodies visible. Rose pink, lavender, pale mint and morning dew.

scenes.title: 樹洞裡的小屋
scenes.caption: 推開一扇，剛剛好的小門
scenes.description: They sit together at the entrance of a tiny cozy tree-hollow home, pig opens the little round wooden door while panda holds a miniature lantern. Moss, acorns and fern details. Warm honey wood, deep emerald and pale gold, no other inhabitants.

scenes.title: 雲朵上的野餐
scenes.caption: 把平凡的一天，帶到天空去
scenes.description: They sit side by side on a softly glowing fantasy cloud island with a little picnic cloth and two tiny cups, panda offers pig a berry. Peaceful miniature floating garden, no falling or danger. Powder blue, peach-pink sky and soft silver-white.

scenes.title: 橡果熱氣球
scenes.caption: 一起升起，去看更遠的風景
scenes.description: Both tiny companions sit securely together in a little acorn-shell basket suspended from a flower-petal hot air balloon, pig holds a small blank map, panda peeks at the forest below. Dreamy sage forest, plum, apricot and sky blue, wide scene.

scenes.title: 原來你也準備了
scenes.caption: 一樣的小心意，兩倍的開心
scenes.description: Pig and panda each reveal an identical tiny wrapped present at the same time, looking at one another with amused surprise. Plain pale sage paper and cream ribbon, warm cottage nook, dusty rose and teal.

scenes.title: 一起打瞌睡
scenes.caption: 連晚安，都剛好同一個節奏
scenes.description: They sit upright shoulder to shoulder on a small sofa, heads gently tilted toward one another and both nodding sleepily, an open blank-covered book resting on their laps. Deep mauve, cream and amber lamplight.

scenes.title: 隔著窗戶揮揮手
scenes.caption: 還沒見面，就先笑了
scenes.description: Pig stands just outside a low open cottage window and panda just inside, at the SAME face height and similar body size, both waving happily toward each other with close faces in right half. Fresh powder blue, pale peach and sage, morning.

scenes.title: 一起聽一面唱片
scenes.caption: 這首歌，留給有你的晚上
scenes.description: They sit close on a soft rug beside a small wooden record player listening quietly, panda rests one paw gently over pig's paw. Pig slightly larger. Indigo, plum and muted gold, cozy cottage evening, no labels on record.

scenes.title: 小爪爪的約定
scenes.caption: 不用說很多，也懂你的心意
scenes.description: Pig and panda gently touch the tips of their small paws in a playful pinky-promise-like gesture without human fingers, smiling at one another. Quiet cottage balcony, soft seafoam, dusty rose and dusk lilac.

scenes.title: 交換今天的小日子
scenes.caption: 你的今天，我也想聽
scenes.description: Both sit side by side exchanging two small notebooks with blank covers, panda offers hers while pig offers his, gentle interested smiles. Cottage writing table, muted blue, warm ivory and sage, soft evening lamp.

scenes.title: 水彩裡的小雨天
scenes.caption: 讓雨滴，暈成溫柔的顏色
scenes.description: Pig and panda walk shoulder to shoulder beneath one small pale yellow umbrella on a garden path. MEDIUM: unmistakable traditional transparent watercolor on textured cold-pressed paper, visible pigment blooms, airy washes and soft edges, hand-painted rounded animal characters, NO realistic fur rendering or 3D. Palette pale indigo, butter yellow, blush pink.

scenes.title: 色鉛筆的小餅乾
scenes.caption: 一筆一畫，都是甜甜的日常
scenes.description: They sit together decorating two small heart-shaped cookies, pig holds icing spoon and panda offers a cookie. MEDIUM: unmistakable hand-drawn colored pencil on cream paper, delicate visible pencil strokes and crosshatching, soft storybook outlines, NO 3D or realistic rendering. Powder blue, warm peach and muted red.

scenes.title: 紙雕月光船
scenes.caption: 把月光，一層一層疊起來
scenes.description: They sit safely together in a tiny paper boat on a still moonlit lake, pig holds a paper lantern and panda looks at crescent moon. MEDIUM: layered handmade cut-paper diorama, visible cardstock edges and gentle paper-layer shadows, flat rounded character silhouettes with friendly faces, NO fluffy realistic fur. Navy, pale teal, ivory and gold.

scenes.title: 黏土的小書房
scenes.caption: 把陪伴，捏成圓圓的樣子
scenes.description: Pig and panda sit side by side sharing a small open blank picture book on a cushion. MEDIUM: handmade soft polymer-clay stop-motion diorama, rounded matte clay shapes and subtle fingerprints, tiny bright eyes, no realistic fur; warm gentle studio light. Pastel sage, peach-pink and cream.

scenes.title: 不透明水彩的花園
scenes.caption: 把春天，塗得飽滿一點
scenes.description: They plant a small daisy together in a terracotta pot, pig uses a trowel while panda steadies the flower. MEDIUM: bold opaque gouache illustration, visible broad brush strokes, simplified warm shapes and chalky matte color, NO realistic fur and NO 3D. Saturated but harmonious cobalt, leaf green, coral and cream.

scenes.title: 粉彩的星空窗邊
scenes.caption: 晚安，留一點星光給你
scenes.description: Pig and panda sit together on a cottage window seat watching a starry sky, gently touching paws. MEDIUM: soft chalk pastel drawing on dark textured paper, visible velvety pigment marks, softly blended edges and little luminous specks, NO photorealism or 3D. Deep violet, powder blue, pink and warm pale yellow.
